script.base: Closed roof, PHI -3, total 47.5, implied PHI 25.2 / DAL 22.2 (pack pro-edge). Market expects a close game, not a blowout, so starters should play it out. PHI leans on Barkley (62 carries, 293 rush yards in weeks 8/10/11) into a DAL run defense allowing 5.02 YPC and 40 runs of 10+. If PHI leads late they clock it on the ground. script.flip1: PHI gets up early behind the run. Barkley carries rise, Hurts/WR volume stalls, and DAL abandons the run so Javonte carries die while Lamb/Pickens targets spike. Barkley rush over survives this flip; a PHI pass-game over would not.
script.flip2: PHI's OL (Lane Johnson Out, Jurgens/Hinton/Lampkin Questionable) folds, PHI trails, and the offense goes quick-pass. Barkley carries fall toward the 44-yard floor in his last four, Goedert/Smith short targets rise, and if DAL leads Javonte's rush line lives. That flip kills a Barkley rush over.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and the Barkley over lost because Johnson was out, Jurgens was inactive, Dallas loaded the box, PHI fell behind, and Barkley finished in the mid-40s on a cut carry share while Bigsby stole the explosives. The Ferguson under lost because Adeniji sat, Prescott sped up, and Ferguson turned checkdowns plus one seam into a 50-yard type day in a pass-heavy dog script. That counter is real and is why Ferguson is only a lean. It is not stronger than Barkley's 20-carry role versus a 5.02 YPC defense at a 59.5 median, so the rush over stays and is flagged, not cut, until a human sees a real no-vig.
slip_story: One story: close dome game, PHI -3 controls the run, DAL scores about 22 without featuring the TE. Stack Barkley rushyds over 59.5 with Ferguson recyds under 36.5.
